# StandupBot

> Auto-generate high-quality PR descriptions using any LLM. Stop hand-writing "fixed stuff" and let a real diff tell the story.

---

## What does StandupBot do?

StandupBot is a GitHub Action that reads the **real diff and commit history** of any Pull Request, runs it through an **OpenAI-compatible LLM** you bring your own key for, and writes a structured **Summary / Changes / Testing** description plus up to three normalized labels — automatically.

No more staring at an empty description box. No more "updated code". No more copy-pasting from your commit messages.

## Key Features

- **🤖 Any LLM, your choice** — Bring your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, or self-hosted
- **📝 Structured output** — Generates `Summary`, `Changes` (file-by-file), `Testing` sections, plus title + labels
- **🛡️ Never overwrites you** — Only writes when the PR description is empty or already has the StandupBot marker
- **⚙️ Configurable** — Tone, max-diff tokens, file exclusion globs via `.standupbot.yml`
- **🚀 Zero config** — Drop in 3 secrets/vars and you're done
- **📦 MIT licensed** — Free, open source, no tracking

## Quick Start

Add `.github/workflows/standupbot.yml` to your repo:

```yaml
name: StandupBot
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  describe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: XenoCyber0/StandUpBot@main
        with:
          llm-base-url: ${{ secrets.LLM_BASE_URL }}
          llm-api-key: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}
          model: ${{ vars.LLM_MODEL }}
```

Set `LLM_API_KEY` as a **secret** and `LLM_MODEL` as a **variable** in your repo settings. Done.

## Sample Output

Here's real output generated by StandupBot for [nodejs/node#64573](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/64573):

```markdown
## Summary
Add `lchownSync` to the VFS implementation so that symbolic link ownership can be changed without following the link, matching the behavior of `fs.lchownSync`.

## Changes
- doc/api/vfs.md: added `lchownSync(path, uid, gid)` to the list of VFS API signatures.
- lib/internal/vfs/file_system.js: added synchronous `lchownSync` method to `VirtualFileSystem` and updated the async wrapper to call `provider.lchownSync`.
- lib/internal/vfs/provider.js: added default `lchownSync` method with JSDoc.

## Testing
New test verifying sync, callback, and promise variants of `lchownSync` on VFS-mounted symlinks.
```

## Configuration

Create `.standupbot.yml` at the repo root to customize:

```yaml
tone: concise              # free-form tone steer
maxDiffTokens: 6000        # diff budget before per-file summarisation
exclude:                   # gitignore-style globs kept out of the prompt
  - package-lock.json
  - '**/*.lock'
  - '**/dist/**'
llm:                       # non-secret connection details
  baseUrl: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
  model: anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet
```

## Inputs

| Input | Env Var | Required | Notes |
|-------|---------|----------|-------|
| `llm-base-url` | `LLM_BASE_URL` | ✅ | e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` |
| `llm-api-key` | `LLM_API_KEY` | ✅ | Secret — never commit this |
| `model` | `LLM_MODEL` | ✅ | Your model identifier |
| `github-token` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | ❌ | Defaults to workflow token |

## Pricing

**Free.** StandupBot is MIT-licensed open source. You only pay your LLM provider for API usage.
